annotations.text:
Same lattice, three motion flows — pick one.

The artwork itself is transparent: the canvas is cleared every frame and nothing paints a ground. The dark field behind it is the Backdrop tweak, set to the site's #101013 so you can judge it in place. Switch it to Transparent to see the alpha.

A · Dolly — pushes in and eases back out. Perfect loop, no seam, reads as depth. Most literal answer to "forward backward".

B · Drift — never stops travelling; cubes recycle through the volume. More cinematic, but it can pull the eye off the headline.

C · Signal — camera nearly still, light travels the edges instead. Calmest behind text; least like the reference's sense of motion.
